(#{e.entryType}, #{e.text}, #{e.pinyin}, #{e.finals}, #{e.rhymeBody}, #{e.yun18}, #{e.wordClass}, #{e.source}, #{e.tier}, #{e.freq}, #{e.note}, datetime('now','localtime'), datetime('now','localtime'))

INSERT INTO rhyme_entry (entry_type, text, pinyin, finals, rhyme_body, yun18, word_class, source, tier, freq, note, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{e.entryType}, #{e.text}, #{e.pinyin}, #{e.finals}, #{e.rhymeBody}, #{e.yun18}, #{e.wordClass}, #{e.source}, #{e.tier}, #{e.freq}, #{e.note}, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = IF(source = 'CORPUS', NOW(), update_time), freq = IF(source = 'CORPUS', VALUES(freq), freq)

INSERT INTO rhyme_entry (entry_type, text, pinyin, finals, rhyme_body, yun18, word_class, source, tier, freq, note, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{e.entryType}, #{e.text}, #{e.pinyin}, #{e.finals}, #{e.rhymeBody}, #{e.yun18}, #{e.wordClass}, #{e.source}, #{e.tier}, #{e.freq}, #{e.note}, datetime('now','localtime'), datetime('now','localtime'))
ON CONFLICT(text, pinyin) DO UPDATE SET update_time = CASE WHEN rhyme_entry.source = 'CORPUS' THEN datetime('now','localtime') ELSE rhyme_entry.update_time END, freq = CASE WHEN rhyme_entry.source = 'CORPUS' THEN excluded.freq ELSE rhyme_entry.freq END
